name: Tranquilizer gun
description: Stuns most monsters from range. Knocks the Huntsman over.

name: Stun weapon / stun grenade
description: Any reliable stun. Needed to grab the Pony, and buys time against Robe and Elsa.

name: Firearm (gun, Human Gun, …)
description: Ranged damage. Safe against things you shouldn't melee.

name: Grenades
description: Burst damage. Stun or frag both help against flyers.

name: Land mines
description: Set traps on patrol routes. Stack several for big monsters.

name: Sledgehammer
description: Heavy melee with good stun. The best general melee pick.

name: Light melee (bat, pan, sword…)
description: Fine against small or fragile monsters.

name: Strength upgrades
description: Lift and slam heavier monsters (3+ for Chef or Rugrat, 7 for Bowtie, 13 for the big ones).

name: Grab range upgrades
description: Grab monsters and teammates from a safer distance.

name: Health packs
description: Heal between encounters. Changes what's safe to risk.
